rooms.name: Porch
rooms.description: You stand outside a quiet house. A locked wooden gate leads north into the garden. A small iron key lies on the doormat.

items.name: Garden Key
items.message: The small key turns in the lock. The wooden gate swings open.

rooms.name: Garden
rooms.description: Tall grass sways around you. An old chest sits beneath a gnarled tree, its lid slightly ajar.

items.name: Chest
items.description: An old wooden chest with a loose lid. Inside you find the missing family ring.
items.message:
You lift the lid of the chest and find the missing family ring nestled inside.

YOU WIN
